narrative: The "unified compressed-KV-cache flag" thesis revives because vLLM v0.24.0 ships multi-tier KV-cache offloading with an object-store secondary tier as a default-path Model Runner V2 capability, moving tiered cache handling from a buried experimental flag toward a first-class serving feature and setting the baseline rival OSS servers must match.
remaining_gap: Today's release is offload-tiering in one stack, not an explicitly named compression-dtype flag unified across the major serving stacks the prediction calls for.
